entries.title: Proverbs 28:1
segments: ¶The wicked flee when no one pursues, But the righteous are bold as a lion.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:2
segments: ¶Because of the transgression of a land, many [are] its princes; But by a man of understanding [and] knowledge Right will be prolonged.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:3
segments: ¶A poor man who oppresses the poor [Is like] a driving rain which leaves no food.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:4
segments: ¶Those who forsake the law praise the wicked, But such as keep the law contend with them.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:5
segments: ¶Evil men do not understand justice, But those who seek the LORD understand all.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:6
segments: ¶Better [is] the poor who walks in his integrity Than one perverse [in his] ways, though he [be] rich.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:7
segments: ¶Whoever keeps the law [is] a discerning son, But a companion of gluttons shames his father.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:8
segments: ¶One who increases his possessions by usury and extortion Gathers it for him who will pity the poor.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:9
segments: ¶One who turns away his ear from hearing the law, Even his prayer [is] an abomination.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:10
segments: ¶Whoever causes the upright to go astray in an evil way, He himself will fall into his own pit; But the blameless will inherit good.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:11
segments: ¶The rich man [is] wise in his own eyes, But the poor who has understanding searches him out.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:12
segments: ¶When the righteous rejoice, [there is] great glory; But when the wicked arise, men hide themselves.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:13
segments: ¶He who covers his sins will not prosper, But whoever confesses and forsakes [them] will have mercy.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:14
segments: ¶Happy [is] the man who is always reverent, But he who hardens his heart will fall into calamity.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:15
segments: ¶[Like] a roaring lion and a charging bear [Is] a wicked ruler over poor people.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:16
segments: ¶A ruler who lacks understanding [is] a great oppressor, [But] he who hates covetousness will prolong [his] days.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:17
segments: ¶A man burdened with bloodshed will flee into a pit; Let no one help him.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:18
segments: ¶Whoever walks blamelessly will be saved, But [he who is] perverse [in his] ways will suddenly fall.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:19
segments: ¶He who tills his land will have plenty of bread, But he who follows frivolity will have poverty enough!

entries.title: Proverbs 28:20
segments: ¶A faithful man will abound with blessings, But he who hastens to be rich will not go unpunished.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:21
segments: ¶To show partiality [is] not good, Because for a piece of bread a man will transgress.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:22
segments: ¶A man with an evil eye hastens after riches, And does not consider that poverty will come upon him.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:23
segments: ¶He who rebukes a man will find more favor afterward Than he who flatters with the tongue.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:24
segments: ¶Whoever robs his father or his mother, And says, "[It is] no transgression," The same [is] companion to a destroyer.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:25
segments: ¶He who is of a proud heart stirs up strife, But he who trusts in the LORD will be prospered.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:26
segments: ¶He who trusts in his own heart is a fool, But whoever walks wisely will be delivered.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:27
segments: ¶He who gives to the poor will not lack, But he who hides his eyes will have many curses.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:28
segments: ¶When the wicked arise, men hide themselves; But when they perish, the righteous increase.
